title: onboard-latitude-7b-v1.0-performance-profiles-and-changelog-automation
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Add Latitude-7B v1.0 model metadata and performance profiles; automated changelog entry generation for model registry. No breaking API changes.
description: Onboard Latitude-7B v1.0 into the model registry with initial metadata, performance profiles for common GPU families, and automated changelog/release-notes generation. Motivation: Latitude-7B is an open checkpoint we want to support as a low-cost, low-latency option for customers with strict latency SLOs. This PR includes: 1) model metadata (tokenizer, hf-checkpoint link, supported sharding/quantization flags), 2) performance profiles measured on A100/H100/T4 (latency p50/p95, throughput at typical batch sizes), 3) quantization and kernel recommendations (8-bit, int4 notes), 4) changes to the registry automation that create a changelog entry when a new model version is added, and 5) small docs updates and unit-tests for profile validation. Checklist: - [x] metadata schema validated - [x] perf profile generation scripts updated - [x] changelog automation tested locally - [x] CI green (unit + profile smoke) - [x] reviews addressed. Related: ENG-2411 (perf onboarding pipeline), PM-98 (product readiness). This description is intentionally continuous and includes context, test notes, and followups.

review_comments: Diego Rivera (reviewer): Left a couple of inline suggestions around the kernel_hints naming and quantization flags. Asked for clarification on how int4 fallback is detected.

Maya Patel (author): replied - renamed kernel_hints -> kernel_recommendation and added explicit 'int4_fallback' boolean in metadata. Added comment to perf script explaining fallback detection based on decoder op coverage.

Priya Nair (reviewer): requested stronger assertions in test_perf_profiles.py to avoid regressions (p50 < 120ms on A100 for sequence=128). Also asked to surface profiling environment metadata (cuda driver, torch/cuda versions) in the perf artifact.
Maya Patel: updated tests to assert p50 thresholds and attached a perf artifact in CI that includes environment metadata. Ran measurements twice to reduce noise and updated YAML with median values.

Samir Gupta (reviewer): asked that changelog entries include a delta line for perf vs other models; suggested the changelog_generator produce a short one-line summary for release notes. Author updated generator to include a 'perf_delta' field and a short summary in the generated markdown.
Samir Gupta: Approves and requested squash-merge with PR title as commit message
